criteria.description: Observable behavior expected to change if the target mechanism is causal.

targetChecks: Verify that the intended target state changed in the intended direction.
nonTargetChecks: Verify that named non-target state variables remained unchanged.
shamChecks: Verify that the sham matches surface form, length, and context while withholding the hypothesized active mechanism.
restorationChecks: Verify that restoring the target mechanism reproduces the baseline intermediate state.
